# marked_text: \2 and \3 stand for the 0x02/0x03 marks the addon puts around links and {...}
#   groups; \4 stands for 0x04, the colour prefix (six hex digits) of a link (addon build 5).
# pairs_json: the glossary pairs the addon sends for this line and target, computed with the real
#   Glossary.Extract (built-in entries and false friends; meanings in French for fr, English for
#   every other target). en02 adds one user entry (mp = whisper).
# expect, ";"-separated: "same" (already in the target language) or "tr" (needs a translation), then
#   use:<term>=a|b  must-use pair: one alternative must appear in the shown text (lowercase, Latin
#                   accents removed). Chat words, false friends and full names are must-use.
#   keep:<term>     keep-allowed pair: a game abbreviation players type as-is in every language
#                   (LFM, WTS, pst, DPS, HC, AFK, GG...); it may stay as typed (the addon's
#                   glossary row explains it). Same list as prompt::keep_allowed in the engine.
#   name=a|b        official localized name (dungeon, zone, city) that must appear.
#   word=a|b        content word showing the line was really translated.
#   copy=<token>    an ID, URL or e-mail address the shown text must hold exactly as written.
#   free=<token>    a level, price or time the engine must not protect (checked on the engine's
#                   own protection, without the model): the model translates it.
